rules.requirement: Publish an annual Modern Slavery and Human Trafficking Statement (Section 54) for organisations with GBP 36M+ turnover, approved by the board and signed by a director, published on the company website with a prominent homepage link. The statement must cover organisation structure, supply chains, due diligence policies, risk assessment, KPIs and training.
rules.recommendation: Draft the s.54 statement covering the 6 required areas, obtain board approval and a director signature, and publish it on the company website with a homepage link.
